my_lead: 1a and 1h co-named in the abstract ('compounds 1a and 1h exhibited enhanced inhibitory effects'); no single best named in the abstract, 1a has the lowest IC50 (4.38 vs 6.64 uM, Table 1)

reactions.issue: Sulfonamide formation (TEA omitted correctly). Aryl cycloamine = 4-(4-bromophenyl)piperidine is inferred from the name of 1a (the general procedure only says 'aryl cycloamine compounds').
Hydrazinolysis of the methyl ester (hydrazine hydrate, EtOH reflux 2 h); hydrazine supplies the N-N atoms so listing it is right.
Hydrazide + alkyl chloroformate, DMAP omitted correctly. Ethyl chloroformate is inferred from the ethyl carbamate in 1a's name (1H 4.15-4.00 2H, 13C 14.6).

Leaves: 'commercially available methyl 4-(chlorosulfonyl)benzoate (4)' (p.2) and 'all reagents and solvents were obtained from commercial suppliers and used without further purification' (4.1). 1a yield 469.6 mg = 92% of 510.4 g/mol at 1.0 mmol, consistent with the ethyl compound.
